svg.data-input-ac: 120 V single-phase, 24 A continuous (agency de-rated, 30 A maximum capacity), 50/60 Hz
svg.data-capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on (SKU, "2.88kW (120V) / 24A total capacity"); it is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
svg.data-output-rating: 24 A total; 20 A per load bank; 16 A per outlet
svg.data-breakers: two 20 A, one per load bank
svg.data-metering: load current in amps for each bank, on the two meters

g.data-description: the load meter of bank 2 (the upper bank)
g.title: meter-2

rect.data-description: the readout window, two seven-segment cells that show the load of one bank in amps

g.data-description: the left digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
the right digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
